# zerops_service_types (Data Source)

Reads the organization service type catalog. Managed versions use qualified family:mode@version names; zerops_service requires this form for dual-mode managed types.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "zerops_service_types" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID; defaults to the provider organization.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resolved organization ID.
- `types` (Attributes List) Catalog types including disabled versions; not every version is creatable. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--types))

<a id="nestedatt--types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `types`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) Category.
- `id` (String) Id.
- `modes` (List of String) Modes.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `operating_systems` (List of String) Operating systems.
- `versions` (Attributes List) Versions sorted by ID, including disabled versions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--types--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--types--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `types.versions`

Read-Only:

- `exact_version_number` (String) Exact version number.
- `id` (String) Id.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `status` (String) Status.
- `version_number` (String) Version number.
